title: One line
description: A music app tab bar drawn with one ink thread — tap a tab and the line pulls out of the old icon stroke by stroke, runs along the bar thinning under tension, and stitches itself into the new one. Drag along the bar to pull it out by hand and let go; it lands on the nearest tab.
intent: Make the tab indicator a single physical thread whose length is conserved, so switching tabs reads as unthreading one icon and stitching the next.
